name: @socioprophet/gbrg-reasoning
description: GBRG causal TRACK 1 — PLN probabilistic-logic risk-propagation over the code graph. Projects GBRG blast-radius ProofArtifacts into a HellGraphStore and runs the REAL pln.ts forwardChain() to derive transitive-risk edges (risk that flows A->C through A->B->C) with per-hop confidence decay. NOT Pearl causal inference.
